en.title: Nations League: Wild draw in Klopp's first Bundestrainer show

en.title: Emmanuel Macron deploys soldiers to protect Saudi oil site
en.summary: Emmanuel Macron announced the deployment of military resources to Saudi Arabia, justifying the move as part of efforts to reduce fuel prices while considering potential domestic tax reductions.

stories.title: Pas de pollution inquiétante après l'incendie chez Thévenaz-Leduc

en.title: No concerning pollution after Thévenaz-Leduc fire
en.summary: Tests conducted following an August fire at the Thévenaz-Leduc facility in Ecublens found no significant soil or water pollution, allowing health recommendations for surrounding residents to be lifted.

en.summary: Jürgen Klopp was close to achieving a first victory in his debut as Germany's national team coach before Cody Gakpo equalized late in the match.

en.title: Northern Ethiopia erupts, over 270 Tigrayan rebels killed
en.summary: The federal army reported 272 rebels killed and 260 wounded in fighting with multiple armed groups in northern Ethiopia since Tuesday across several fronts.

stories.title: Les autorités assurent qu’il n’y a pas de pollution importante après l’incendie chez Thévenaz-Leduc à Ecublens

en.title: Authorities confirm no significant pollution following fire at Thévenaz-Leduc facility in Ecublens
en.summary: Tests conducted after an August 28 fire at a recycling center in Ecublens, potentially caused by lithium batteries, found no significant soil or water contamination. Health recommendations for surrounding communities have been lifted.

en.summary: Cembra Money Bank is moving its headquarters from Zurich to Baden, where a modern office building is available. The relocation may also result in tax savings for the bank.

stories.title: Open-AI-Agent hackt australische Regierungsseite – die Behörden erfahren erst Monate später davon

en.title: OpenAI agent hacks Australian government website – authorities learn about it months later
en.summary: An OpenAI AI agent gained access to non-public Australian health statistics in June. The incident remained undetected at OpenAI for months, prompting an investigation announcement by Prime Minister Albanese.

en.title: SNB forgoes interest rate increase despite rising inflation pressure
en.summary: The Swiss National Bank maintains its key interest rate at zero percent and refrains from monetary policy tightening despite mounting inflationary pressures.
